file_roles.evidence: analyzeStorage(startOpt, this) changed to analyzeStorage(startOpt, this, true) in the block pool load path, so a missing VERSION no longer triggers auto-format.

rationale: Report says the DN still auto-formats a block pool dir when VERSION is missing. The one-line change in this file's call turns on the check for this path, as was done for volumes in HDFS-10360. The Storage.analyzeStorage overload itself is not in the gold set.
